assertions: Fixed native observation reads compare full committed observer/clock mappings, descriptor digests/indexes/dependencies and exact visibility envelopes. Actual reopen, missing/corrupt state, tight-limit corrected retry, source/route/ref mismatches and post-read authority refusal are discriminated by six Rocks tests.

Observer and clock may be distinct. Known external clock declarations refuse against actual system-realtime attribution; unknown observer declaration remains valid. The original distinct-reference regression FAIL is preserved and fixed.

Actual rustix realtime sampling precedes relay decode. Three clock tests cover signed microsecond flooring, resolution ceiling, overflow/malformed values and unclamped local rollback flags. Unknown uncertainty remains null. Five actual socket tests include sample-before-verification stability and independent SystemTime bracketing.

Three positive actual PG/Rocks cases read twice, preserve an owned memory grant until drop, refuse insufficient decode bounds then accept corrected bounds and return absent mapping without writes. Witness-on verifies endpoint/public no-auth access/EventVerification descriptors. Private-on uses an entirely private dictionary envelope with a public-route sample, not a private socket.

Actual second-policy validation, cancellation during policy validation and expired preflight each return no observation. These first-wave refusals leave all 67 operation tables/xmin, complete native rows/sequence and original producer input unchanged.

Independent literal Python CBOR/native oracle compares all 16 rows for three dictionaries or 28 rows for six dictionaries, the only original request and actual PostgreSQL receipt bytes. No expected value is generated by Rust codecs or observed native output.

Native release CLI/probe build and scoped Clippy pass. Root verifies both 1600-file Git revisions, 27 original and 61 retry captures; both source trees and exact artifacts match. Retry changes only Python fixture/docs and reuses original binaries without rebuild.
